hitl_conditions: No explicit conditions. The paper says AI modelling removes dependence on the user's parameter settings and aims at unmanned factories with zero human handling; humans keep only offline design of reward function, observation/action parameters and learning options.
key_finding: PPO agent (Stable-Baselines3 in FlexSim) choosing which item type each router pulls from the stocker cut stocker average waiting time from 3348 s (FIFO) to 145 s and mean queue from about 272 to 12 items at similar daily output (7304 vs 7058); converged after 3000-8000 training steps.

quotes.text: First, we defined an RL environment, modeled it, and validated its ability to simulate a real physical system.
The stocker simulation model was used to validate the effectiveness of RL. The model is a storage device that simulates logistics in a manufacturing production area.
The simulation environment that is validated in this study is a component of a production line that produces battery management systems.
Stockers operate in conjunction with a logistics automation system to streamline the supply chain process and can perform additional functions such as splitting, merging, and flipping as required.
To implement RL, we used the PPO algorithm from the Stable-Baseline3 library [31], which is known for its effectiveness in solving numerous problems.
Intelligent logistics solutions can reduce the production lead time by calculating optimal routes through machine learning and zero human handling of products and data to promote unmanned factories.
